title: Synthwave Dreams
logline: In the dark expanse of deep space, a lone astronaut uncovers a shocking conspiracy that threatens to reshape humanity's perception of reality.
synopsis: Astronaut Mia Chen is sent on a routine maintenance mission to an abandoned research station orbiting a distant star. As she descends into the station's eerie corridors, strange phenomena begin to manifest, blurring the lines between dream and reality. Mia discovers that a powerful corporation, known only as 'The Dreamers,' has infiltrated the station and is manipulating everyone's subconscious to maintain control over society. With limited resources and time running out, Mia must race against the clock to uncover the truth before it's too late, all while fighting off the hallucinatory creatures that threaten to destroy her sanity. In a climactic battle through the twisted dreamscape, Mia faces her deepest fears and uncovers the shocking identity of 'The Dreamers,' leading her on an intense journey to expose the conspiracy and free humanity from its grasp.

characters.name: Mia Chen
characters.description: A hardened astronaut with a troubled past, Mia is driven by a desire for justice and the safety of humanity. She possesses a sharp mind and an unwavering determination to uncover the truth, even in the face of overwhelming odds.

characters.name: Dr. Viktor Sato
characters.description: The charismatic leader of 'The Dreamers,' Dr. Sato is a brilliant scientist with a dark ideology. He believes that manipulating people's dreams is the key to controlling their lives, and he will stop at nothing to achieve his goal.

characters.name: Eliara
characters.description: A mysterious figure who aids Mia in her mission, Eliara brings a unique set of skills to the team. She is fiercely loyal to Mia and becomes an integral part of her journey as they navigate the dangers of the research station.
